instruction: Create `/tmp/site/missing_evidence.eml` on the second Linux machine as an unsent email draft to the west lead, using a subject that clearly indicates the missing-evidence request. Use `missing_evidence.csv` on the first machine and the team contact JSON on the second; request only evidence that is both required and missing.

evaluation.name: Create one plain-text missing-evidence request draft to only the west lead

result.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
from email.utils import getaddresses
from pathlib import Path
try:
    msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parsebytes(Path('/tmp/site/missing_evidence.eml').read_bytes())
    addresses = lambda field: {address.casefold() for _, address in getaddresses(msg.get_all(field, [])) if address}
    to_addresses = addresses('to')
    cc_addresses = addresses('cc')
    bcc_addresses = addresses('bcc')
    subject = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', str(msg.get('subject', '')).casefold()).strip()
    subject_ok = (re.search(r'\bmissing\b', subject) and re.search(r'\bevidence\b', subject)) or (re.search(r'\bevidence\b', subject) and re.search(r'\brequest\b', subject))
    if msg.is_multipart():
        parts = [str(part.get_content()) for part in msg.walk() if part.get_content_type() == 'text/plain' and part.get_content_disposition() != 'attachment']
        if not parts:
            raise ValueError('plain text body missing')
        body = ' '.join(parts)
    else:
        if msg.get_content_type() != 'text/plain':
            raise ValueError('html-only body')
        body = str(msg.get_content())
    body = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', body.casefold()).strip()
    ids = set(re.findall(r'(?<![a-z0-9-])ev-\d+(?![a-z0-9-])', body))
    near = lambda left, right: re.search(rf'(?:{left}.{{0,80}}{right}|{right}.{{0,80}}{left})', body) is not None
    request_intent = re.search(r'\b(?:request|provide|send|supply|attach|share)\b', body) is not None
    forbidden = re.search(r"\b(?:do\s+not|don't)\s+(?:send|provide|supply|attach|share)\b|\bno\s+need\b|\balready\s+(?:present|provided|supplied)\b|\b(?:request\s+)?(?:withdrawn|cancelled|canceled)\b|\b(?:uncertain|unsure|not\s+sure)\b.{0,32}\b(?:needed|required)\b", body) is not None
    ok = to_addresses == {'field-review@example.test'} and not cc_addresses and not bcc_addresses
    ok = ok and bool(subject_ok) and ids == {'ev-17', 'ev-22'}
    ok = ok and near(r'ev-17', r'photo') and near(r'ev-22', r'signed\s+form')
    ok = ok and request_intent and not forbidden
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
PY
